title: अर्जुन को केवल चिड़िया की आँख क्यों दिखी?
source: Mahabharata, Adi Parva (public-domain epic; this retelling and these designs are our own)
caption: Guru Dronacharya ki pariksha aur Arjun ka woh jawab jo aaj bhi focus ki sabse badi misaal hai.

shots.subject: 1boy, solo, original, elderly indian sage teacher, long white beard, white hair in a bun, white robes, wooden prayer beads, standing in a forest hermitage courtyard, thatched huts, sacred fire, morning mist, wide shot
shots.motion: Anime style. An elderly sage teacher in white robes stands in a forest hermitage courtyard; smoke rises from the sacred fire, mist drifts, leaves fall. He slowly turns his head. Slow camera push-in. Smooth natural motion.
shots.line: गुरु द्रोणाचार्य ने अपने शिष्यों की परीक्षा ली।

shots.subject: no humans, original, small carved wooden bird toy perched on a high tree branch, painted eye, green leaves, sunlight through canopy, shallow depth of field, close-up
shots.motion: Anime style. A small carved wooden bird sits still on a high branch while leaves sway in the wind and sunlight flickers through the canopy. Slow camera tilt up toward the bird. Smooth natural motion.
shots.line: पेड़ की डाल पर लकड़ी की एक चिड़िया रखी गई।

shots.subject: 1boy, solo, original, elderly indian sage teacher, long white beard, white hair in a bun, white robes, wooden prayer beads, pointing upward with one hand, stern expression, forest background, upper body
shots.motion: Anime style. An elderly sage teacher with a long white beard raises his arm and points up toward the treetops, speaking sternly. His robes and beard move in the breeze. Static camera. Smooth natural motion.
shots.line: गुरु ने पूछा, बताओ, तुम्हें क्या दिखाई देता है?

shots.subject: 1boy, solo, original, young indian warrior prince, archer, brown skin, long black hair in a topknot, small golden crown, ornate blue and gold armor over white dhoti, red sash, golden armbands, walking forward holding a longbow, forest clearing, cowboy shot, calm confident expression
shots.motion: Anime style. A young warrior prince in blue and gold armor steps forward through a forest clearing holding his longbow, calm and confident. His red sash and hair sway. Camera slowly tracks backward. Consistent face, smooth natural motion.
shots.line: सबने पेड़ और पत्ते गिनाए। फिर अर्जुन आगे आए।

shots.subject: 1boy, solo, original, young indian warrior prince, archer, brown skin, long black hair in a topknot, small golden crown, ornate blue and gold armor, golden armbands, drawing a longbow, arrow nocked, aiming upward, intense focused eyes, close-up portrait, forest light
shots.motion: Anime style. Close-up of a young warrior prince drawing his bow, the arrow beside his cheek, eyes narrowing in total focus. The bowstring tightens, strands of hair move in the wind. Very slow camera push-in. Consistent face, smooth natural motion.
shots.line: अर्जुन बोले, मुझे केवल चिड़िया की आँख दिखती है।

shots.subject: 1boy, solo, original, young indian warrior prince, archer, brown skin, long black hair in a topknot, small golden crown, ornate blue and gold armor over white dhoti, red sash, golden armbands, releasing an arrow from a longbow, dynamic pose, from side, wind, golden light, forest
shots.motion: Anime style. A young warrior prince releases an arrow from his longbow; the string snaps forward, his hair and red sash whip in the wind, golden light flares. He lowers the bow with a faint smile. Static camera. Consistent face, smooth natural motion.
shots.line: तीर छूटा और सीधा निशाने पर लगा।
